title: Beyond Fluent Responses: Finding User Dissatisfaction in Human-AI Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2611.13894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models generate increasingly high-quality responses, recent work on response evaluation has moved beyond response-centered criteria, such as correctness and coherence, toward user-centered criteria, including user preferences and perceived usefulness. This shift is fundamentally important for developing technologies that are truly useful to real-world users. While conventional response evaluation quantifies the quality of the response itself, users' satisfaction in real conversations also depends on their subjective preferences and perceptions of usefulness, which do not necessarily align with response quality. This study investigates whether such user-centered signals can be detected from conversational text. Specifically, we analyze user utterances with self-reported dissatisfaction labels to examine whether user dissatisfaction in text can be detected. translated_title: 超越流畅回答：在人机交互中发现用户不满
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型生成的回答质量日益提高，近期的回答评估工作已经超越了以回答为中心的标准（如正确性和连贯性），转向以用户为中心的标准，包括用户偏好和感知有用性。这一转变对于开发真正对现实世界用户有用的技术至关重要。尽管传统的回答评估量化的是回答本身的质量，但用户在真实对话中的满意度还取决于其主观偏好和对有用性的感知，而这些并不一定与回答质量相一致。本研究探讨了能否从对话文本中检测出这类以用户为中心的信号。具体而言，我们分析了带有自我报告不满标签的用户话语，以检验能否从文本中检测到用户的不满。在英语交互中，使用用户话语的模型超过了（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过分析带有自我报告不满标签的用户话语，证明人机交互中用户的不满情绪可以从对话文本中被检测出来，从而将回答评估从以回答为中心的质量指标拓展到以用户为中心的信号。
en_tdlr: This study shows that user dissatisfaction in human-AI interactions can be detected from user utterances in conversational text, extending response evaluation beyond response-centric quality metrics toward user-centric signals.
